ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino-acid deamination by Penicillium roqueforti contributes to deacidification to pH 6.8.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol and indole from tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism by milk microbiota, low intensity.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin plus P. roqueforti proteases, partly masked by 1.8% salt.

blue_moldy.reason: Abundant 2-heptanone and 2-nonanone from P. roqueforti beta-oxidation and decarboxylation of fatty acids.

browning.reason: Maillard between proteolysis-derived amino acids and residual galactose on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate fermentation in high-fat curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very high butyric acid 12218 mg/kg and hexanoic acid 7919 mg/kg from P. roqueforti lipase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 35.3% fat, ~57% FDM plus blue proteolysis softening casein to rich creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Rennet-set, uncooked pierced curd fractures along blue fissures and air channels.

firmness.reason: Moisture 38.3% pierced blue body is firm yet yielding, softer than Stilton.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism, masked by ketones.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butyrate and ethyl hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by mold esterases.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic acids; hexanoic alone not goaty.

malty_nutty.reason: Modest 2-/3-methylbutanal and methylbutanol from leucine/isoleucine Strecker degradation during ripening.

melt.reason: Rennet curd at pH 6.8 with intact para-casein flows with fat release when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol and 1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid oxidation by Penicillium mycelium.

oil_off.reason: High free fat from lipolyzed cream-enriched curd releases oil on melting.

smoky.reason: No smoking and no guaiacol formation during indoor ripening.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 1837 mg/kg from lactate/citrate metabolism, buffered by lactate consumption and ammonia.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching; rennet blue curd shows short crumbly pull only.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Limited methionine to methanethiol and dimethyl sulfide by lactococci and P. roqueforti, no cooking.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted, slight sweetness from glycerol, free amino acids and annatto-associated perception.

umami.reason: Glutamate release from rennet and P. roqueforti aspartyl proteases during 3-month proteolysis.
